_comment: Information-value ordering for 做 items inside one market (PLAN_V1_1_AMENDMENT_1 section 4.2, last paragraph). score = prior^w_prior * ci_crossing^w_ci_crossing * p_reach^w_p_reach, each factor in [0,1], rounded to 6 decimals; ties by candidate_id ascending. PROPOSED weights for the coordinator to review at merge; the pin is in services/promotion-engine/value.js (editing means two places and a coordinator merge).
ci_crossing_definition: 0 if ci.upper <= threshold; 1 if ci.lower >= threshold; otherwise (ci.upper - threshold) / (ci.upper - ci.lower): the share of the 95% interval that lies above the minimum economic value
